issues.description: Method visibility contradiction for helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the Problem Statement explicitly instructs students to implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as public, but both the provided template and the reference solution define this helper as private. The UML diagram in the problem statement also indicates a private visibility for singFarmSongVerse. This inconsistent guidance (text vs. UML/template/solution) can confuse students about the intended access level and lead to incorrect implementations or unexpected grading/test behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility requirement consistent across materials. Either update problem_statement.md to instruct that singFarmSongVerse(Animal) should be private (to match the UML, template, and solution) or change the template, solution, and UML to declare the helper as public. Preferably update the textual instruction to say the helper is private (and clarify that tests call the public singFarmSong() only), or if a public helper is truly required for tests, update the template and solution method signatures and the UML accordingly.
